visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Anchor link that goes nowhere
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Tapping "Jump to prices" does nothing, because the link points to an id that does not exist on the page. Make the link and the section agree.
visualizerParams.buggyCode:
Jump to prices

Lots of text.

Prices

Tea costs 5.

solution.code:
Jump to prices

Lots of text.

Prices

Tea costs 5.
solution.explanation: The part after # in a link must match the id of an element exactly, including the letters. A small difference like price and prices makes the link silently do nothing.

checks.label: The link target exists on the page
The target is the Prices heading
